observations: Two camera body grips in plastic bags, one yellow, one camouflage green.
Each has a small white label with 'Can 5D4' written on it.
The grips appear to be made of molded rubber or silicone with textured surfaces and cutouts for buttons and dials.
No visible branding or model markings on the grips themselves.
The seller claims compatibility with multiple DSLR models including Nikon D7200, D7000, D750, D810, D610 and Canon 5D mark4, 700D.
